title: R' Abba bar Marya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Midrash Shmuel 1:7 mentions him saying in the name of R’ Yitzchak that prayer is greater than sacrifices. Hyman notes that some read bar Madya, and Yalkut on I Samuel, section 77, reads R’ Abba bar Yosef. Hyman cites the commentary abbreviated הר״ח, understood as Rabbeinu Chananel, for Rav Acha bar Chivra, called Abba bar Mari, at Gittin 35a. Hyman gives Ayya Mari as the reading in his text.

notes.text: Marya, Madya, Yosef and Mari are the supplied name witnesses. The final איה מרי form remains obscure and is not converted into a securely established personal name.

No matching whole Midrash Shmuel, Yalkut or הר״ח paragraph was supplied or newly read. A Tosafot Rid discovery hit is not a Rabbeinu Chananel witness. Midrash and Rabbeinu Chananel remain contextual work expansions, explicitly qualified, rather than newly proven bibliography. Marya, Madya, Yosef and Mari remain Hyman's attributed forms; final איה מרי is obscure and not silently repaired to Abba Mari. Prayer GREATER THAN sacrifices preserves the comparison. Full Rav Acha remains supplied, while uninspected abbreviated personal titles remain R'.

The consulted Midrash Shmuel names R’ Abba bar Madya, and Yalkut names R’ Abba bar Yosef. In the consulted Gittin 35a, a divorce document names Acha bar Hidya, called Ayya Mari. Hyman repeats Chivra and Abba bar Mari in his separate notice on Acha, crediting the commentary there as well. The exact Rabbeinu Chananel witness remains uncollated, and the occurrences do not settle whether any of the named figures are identical.
